name: Forestry mulching / brush clearing service
one_liner: Local land-clearing service that uses a financed skid steer or mulcher to clear overgrown brush for property owners.
customer: Rural and semi-rural landowners, homeowners with overgrown land, developers
offer: Day-rate brush clearing and forestry mulching
how_it_makes_money: About $2,000/day; average job about $3,100; claimed ~85% net margin
startup_cost: low-medium (rent a skid steer, or finance machinery at 0% over 60 months)
tools: Skid steer / forestry mulcher (rented or financed)
evidence: First month ~$17-18k revenue at 85% net margin (6Q6jS1-5pkw)
Founder had never done home services or used the machine (6Q6jS1-5pkw)
risks: UK demand and land-use rules differ from Texas/Ohio
Needs an operator unless you do the work yourself

name: AI-graphics Etsy print-on-demand
one_liner: Research Etsy bestsellers, generate designs with AI, and list them as print-on-demand products with automated fulfilment.
customer: Etsy shoppers buying niche apparel, mugs and prints
how_it_makes_money: Margin on each sale above the POD base cost; optional paid ads
time_to_first_revenue: Weeks (described as a weekend to learn, ~8 hours)
evidence: 'You can make 100 grand a year doing this strategy' — claim, no case shown (6QThtf2K1r4)
'Basically zero startup costs' and can be automated (6QThtf2K1r4)
risks: Weak evidence: no real revenue case
Etsy policy on AI content and IP/trademark takedowns

name: AI automation retainer for enterprises
one_liner: Audit a company's roles and open job posts, then build AI automations and train staff so the company can avoid new hires.
customer: Large / Fortune 500 companies with many open roles
offer: Monthly AI automation build-out plus staff training
evidence: Operator sells $7k/month to Fortune 500, 33% in-person close rate (6aUtwj27IpE)
Guarantee: finds savings above the fee or donates to a charity of the client's choice (6aUtwj27IpE)
Fortune 200 executives 'don't know how to use AI tools' (9uBW16KlwB4)
risks: Closing happens in person, which conflicts with async-first
Delivery depends on real automation skill

name: Automated low-ticket bookkeeping with automation upsell

customer: Small businesses; the operator focused on CPA firms
offer: $50/month automated accounting services plus automation implementation
how_it_makes_money: Subscription (140 clients × $50 ≈ $7-8k/month) plus upsell revenue; ~$16k/month total claimed
evidence: 24-year-old has 140 clients at $50/month, ~$8k/month from accounting alone (6aUtwj27IpE)
~$16k/month in total, about 1 hour/week of work, 'sticky customers' (6aUtwj27IpE)
